summary.tldr: The bill would require the Minister of Canadian Heritage to maintain the Court Challenges Program and set reporting rules for it.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Canadian Heritage to establish and run the Court Challenges Program, through an independent organisation that funds test cases of national importance.
Limits the program’s purpose to cases that seek to clarify and assert constitutional and quasi-constitutional official language rights and Charter human rights.

Requires the program’s administrator to file a yearly report on its work, funding, outreach, goals, and financial performance, plus the number of funding requests denied for each of the program’s two parts.
Requires the minister to table that annual report in each House of Parliament within the first 15 sitting days after receiving it.
summary.background: The bill amends the Department of Canadian Heritage Act. It refers to a program administered by an organisation independent of the Government of Canada and linked to the Official Languages Act.
